armyRules.name: Faceless Hydra
armyRules.flavor: The Legion is never quite where the enemy thinks it is.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks made from more than 18" away.
drawbacks: While no other friendly Alpha Legion Unit is within 12" of its Unit, a Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: while no other friendly Alpha Legion unit is within 12"

armyRules.name: Sabotage Cell
armyRules.flavor: One saboteur in the right place ends a whole armoured column.
benefits: Once per battle, at the start of an enemy Player Turn, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Vehicle within 18" of a Unit with this Special Rule. That Vehicle gains the Stunned Tactical Status.
drawbacks: A Unit that uses this benefit cannot Rush during its next Player Turn.

armyRules.name: Many Masks
armyRules.flavor: Which of them is the real one? The enemy rarely finds out in time.
benefits: An attack with the Precision (X) Special Rule made by an enemy Model cannot be allocated to a Model with this Special Rule unless it is the last Model remaining in its Unit.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic.

wargear.name: Mirror-cloak
wargear.summary: A shimmering mantle that throws back a dozen false outlines of its wearer.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Mirror-cloak has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule. If it already has the Shrouded (X) Special Rule, X is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 2+).

wargear.name: Reagent injector
wargear.summary: A wrist-mounted cocktail of stimms and counter-toxins, tuned for agents who expect to be poisoned in return.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Reagent injector has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Sleeper-cell beacon
wargear.summary: A tiny pulse-caster that lets scattered cells act on a single plan without a word on the vox.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Sleeper-cell beacon, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool and Intelligence Characteristics.

wargear.name: Cell pennant
wargear.summary: A scrap of cloth in the cell's private colours, worn by whoever the cell trusts.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Cell pennant gives its Unit the Cell Swap Special Rule.

wargear.name: Venom-bladder harness
wargear.summary: Glands and reservoirs that coat every blade the bearer carries.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Venom-bladder harness has the Venom Laced Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ghost-signal scrambler
wargear.summary: A vox-mimic that fills the enemy's channels with orders that never came.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Ghost-signal scrambler gives its Unit the Signal Ghost Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dead-drop cache
wargear.summary: A buried crate of the right ammunition, left exactly where the plan said.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Dead-drop cache gives its Unit the Cache Opened Special Rule.

wargear.name: Chameleonic hull-skin
wargear.summary: A pigment-shifting coat that is hard to find and harder to hold in a sight.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Chameleonic hull-skin has the Shifting Hull Special Rule.

wargear.name: Mirror-smoke dischargers
wargear.summary: Smoke charged with reflective grit so the hull seems to be in three places at once.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Mirror-smoke dischargers has the Mirror Smoke Special Rule.

rules.name: Cell Network
rules.summary: Each cell trusts the others to be exactly where the plan says.
rules.text: While at least one other friendly Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making a Cool Check.

rules.name: Sleeper Strike
rules.summary: They were standing beside you before the war began.
rules.text: In its Controlling Player's first Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls. A Unit with this Special Rule must be deployed on the Battlefield using the Infiltrate (X) Special Rule and cannot start the battle in Reserves.

rules.name: Many Heads
rules.summary: Alpharius is present, and three other Alpharii are also present.
rules.text: After both Players have finished deploying, the Controlling Player may swap the positions of two of their Units with this Special Rule that are deployed in the same Deployment Zone. Neither Unit may be Embarked upon a Vehicle.

rules.name: Purge Resolve
rules.summary: A Dreadwing line does not break while its brothers stand beside it.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule automatically passes every Cool Check it is required to make while it is within 6" of at least one other friendly Unit with this Special Rule.

rules.name: Cell Swap
rules.summary: A cell vanishes from one place and a different one takes its seat.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the end of its Move Sub-Phase, a Unit with this Special Rule that is not Locked in Combat may swap places with one friendly Alpha Legion Infantry Unit that is within 6", is not Locked in Combat and has an equal or lower number of Models. Each Unit is placed so that its Models are as close as possible to where the other Unit stood, and in unit coherency.

rules.name: Venom Laced
rules.summary: Every blade the bearer carries has been dipped in something unpleasant.
rules.text: Each Melee Weapon carried by a Model with this Special Rule has the Poisoned (5+) Special Rule. If it already has the Poisoned (X) Special Rule, the value of X is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 2+.

rules.name: Signal Ghost
rules.summary: The enemy's vox channels fill with orders that never came.
rules.text: While an enemy Unit is more than 12" from a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, that enemy Unit cannot make a Reaction in response to anything the Unit with this Special Rule does.

rules.name: Cache Opened
rules.summary: The right ammunition, left exactly where the plan said.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, the Controlling Player may declare that the cache is opened. For the duration of that Shooting Attack, every Ranged Weapon used by that Unit has the Armourbane Special Rule and every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Shifting Hull
rules.summary: A hull the colour of whatever it passes.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks made from more than 24" away. If the Model did not move during its previous Move Sub-Phase, it has Shrouded (5+) against those Shooting Attacks instead.

rules.name: Mirror Smoke
rules.summary: Smoke charged with reflective grit, so the hull seems to be in three places at once.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of an enemy Shooting Phase, the Controlling Player may release Mirror Smoke. Until the start of its next Player Turn, every Hit Test made for a Shooting Attack that targets a Model with this Special Rule is subject to a -1 modifier. That Model cannot make Shooting Attacks in its next Player Turn.

Any Recon Legionary may exchange their Astartes shotgun for a Coil-spined needle carbine

The unit may carry a Sleeper-cell beacon
The unit may carry a Cell pennant
The Sergeant may wear a Venom-bladder harness
Agent's kit: may take up to two items

The Saboteur may carry a Cell-charge satchel

modifiers.text: Trained to kill the head, not the body: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Every legionary a cell leader: +1 IN, -1 LD.
Shadow-killers with no home to return to: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Hardened by purge after purge: +1 LD, -1 M.

rites.name: A Hundred Cells, One Hand
rites.flavor: No cell knows the plan. Every cell knows its part.
benefits: Headhunter Kill Teams, Seeker Squads and Reconnaissance Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Cell Network: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while another friendly unit with Cell Network is within 12".
limitations: At least two Headhunter Kill Teams are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

require.note: Field at least two Headhunter Kill Teams.

modifiers.text: A Hundred Cells, One Hand: Cell Network, Line (1).

rites.name: The Sleeper Awakens
rites.flavor: They were standing beside you before the war began.
benefits: Tactical, Veteran Tactical and Inductii Squads gain Infiltrate (9).
Those units gain Sleeper Strike: in the controlling player's first turn they add +2 to their Charge Rolls.
limitations: No Transport, Heavy Transport or Fast Attack units.
Units with Sleeper Strike must be deployed on the table with Infiltrate; they may not start in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Sleeper Awakens: Sleeper Strike, Infiltrate (9).

rites.name: The Hydra's Gambit
rites.flavor: Alpharius is present, and three other Alpharii are also present.
benefits: Exodus, Headhunter Kill Teams and Mor Deythan Squads gain Many Heads and Outflank. After both sides have deployed, the Controlling Player may swap the positions of two Units with Many Heads.
Exodus and Mor Deythan Squads gain Hatred (Command), as the Headhunter Kill Teams already have.
limitations: Alpharius must be in the army.
At most one Tactical Squad and no Veteran Tactical Squads.

modifiers.text: The Hydra's Gambit: Many Heads, Outflank.

rites.name: Dreadwing Purge-Host
rites.flavor: When the whispers fail, the Dreadwing is sent to finish the argument.
benefits: Dreadwing Interemptor and Lernaean Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Purge Resolve: they automatically pass Cool Checks while within 6" of another friendly Unit with Purge Resolve.
Interemptor Squads gain Line (1) and Scouring Flame: their Plasma burners have Shred (6+). Lernaean Terminator Squads improve Line (1) to Line (2).
limitations: At least two Dreadwing Interemptor Squads are required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

require.note: Field at least two Interemptor Squads.

rules.name: Scouring Flame
rules.summary: The Dreadwing's flamers are not asked to leave anything standing.
rules.text: Each Plasma burner carried by a Model with this Special Rule has the Shred (6+) Special Rule.
